orbis-compat is MIT-licensed, with two named exceptions. Both files say so in their own
headers; each file's SPDX-License-Identifier is authoritative for that file.

  cmake/orbis-tls.ld     GPL-3.0-only. It is the OpenOrbis PS4 Toolchain's own link.x (release
                         v0.5.4, asset toolchain-llvm-18.tar.gz) with two match patterns added to
                         the .tls rule. That toolchain is GPL-3.0 and grants no linking exception,
                         so this derivative cannot be relicensed. It carried an MIT header until
                         2026-09-17; that header was wrong.

  include/sys/ioccom.h   BSD-3-Clause. Its macros follow FreeBSD's sys/sys/ioccom.h because they
                         encode an ABI and cannot be written differently and still work.

The MIT terms below cover everything else in this repository.
